items.title: State the enforcement_implemented value for advisory-pinned runs
items.reason: Section 6.1 changes the field from literal false to true for active enforced governance but does not say what an advisory-pinned active run reports; implementers and run-state tests could reasonably diverge. Define it as boolean = pinnedMode === "enforced" (false for advisory-pinned, uninitialized, and v1_compat), preserving the existing literal-false contract for every pre-slice state.

items.title: Rescore W6 to 8 after reconciliation expanded its concrete scope
items.reason: v1.6 made W6 concrete: ApplyPlanReviewBudgetInput and mode/threshold/B sourcing, mode on three types plus codec default and v9 round-trip, snapshot UUID relocation, six snapshot field groups across payload/record/codec/facade/index, the governance composition and gate projection, one shared protocol/invoke writer, reviewer and author context projection, warning/run-state/config/TOML updates, and eight test files. That surface matches W2/W5 (8), not W3/W4 (5); the zero architecture delta is right but the effort is not. The reviewer independent estimate already reflects this, so the item adds no effort of its own.
